build_task_template: build a PHYRE task template with a ball, horizontal bar, and jar using define_task_template decorator
add_dynamic_ball: create a dynamic ball object in the PHYRE scene with configurable scale and position
add_static_bar: create a static bar object in the PHYRE scene with configurable scale and position
update_task_relationships: update the PHYRE task to define TOUCHING relationships between a ball and jar body
set_solution_tier: set the PHYRE task metadata to specify the TWO_BALLS solution tier
